name: AI-OSINT-Security-Analyzer
description: AI agent (Cohere Command A+) that investigates IPs, domains, CVEs, and software versions using Shodan, VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, NVD, CISA KEV, and EPSS, then writes an evidence-backed threat assessment. Streamlit web app.

paragraphs: An AI agent that investigates IP addresses, domains, CVEs and software versions across several threat-intelligence sources. It then writes an evidence-based security assessment. Cohere's Command A+ model decides which tools to run, and every finding in the report is tied back to the source that produced it.
features: Agentic investigation: the model plans and chains tool calls based on what it finds, within a per-run budget.

Version-accurate vulnerability matching: CVEs are checked against NVD's structured CPE affected-version ranges, so nginx 1.20.1 is not reported as vulnerable to a bug fixed in 1.20.1. Each CVE is labelled affected,…
Exploit-aware prioritisation: findings are enriched with CISA KEV (exploited in the wild), CVSS (v4.0 → v2 fallback) and FIRST EPSS exploit probability.
Exposure and reputation: Shodan services and banners, VirusTotal engine detections (with the names of flagging vendors) and AbuseIPDB abuse reports.
Analysis depth levels: Quick Scan, Standard, Comprehensive and Expert. Each level sets how many tool calls the agent may make, protecting free-tier quotas.
